propositions: a failed identity write (add_label or set_entity_property) deletes the freshly created jira issue via rollback, destroying recoverable work
the deletion leaves a keyed-pending binding pointing to the deleted key, which recover_pending retries against on every pass, permanently stranding the local ticket

record_pending_key binds the key before identity writes execute, so recover_pending's keyed branch already exists to retro-attach labels and properties deterministically without search in exactly this window

jira rejects identity field writes with misleading "field not on screen" errors in at least three situations: field genuinely absent from create/edit screen, workflow property jira.permission.createclone.denied set, or malformed field value
stop deleting the issue on identity-write failure; retain it keyed-pending for recover_pending to retro-attach, leaving re-raised write_err unmasked so the failure remains visible
declare labels as a requirement on the project's create and edit screens rather than implement createmeta pre-flight discovery
